The '''''Starcat''-class Freighter''' was a custom designed [[Starship/Legends|starship]] model built by [[Salem Victory]] and [[Dapp Solus]]. The ''[[Starcat (light freighter)|Starcat]]'' was the only known vessel of the class.<ref name="Scout">{{JournalCite|13|Scouts' Dispatch}}</ref>
